milestones.description: ReplicatedStorage.RoundState is a StringValue with a valid Intermission, Playing or Ended phase.
milestones.check:
local state = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("RoundState")
if not state or not state:IsA("StringValue") then
    return false, "ReplicatedStorage.RoundState StringValue is missing"
end
if state.Value ~= "Intermission" and state.Value ~= "Playing" and state.Value ~= "Ended" then
    return false, "RoundState must use Intermission, Playing or Ended"
end
return true, "Current RoundState is " .. state.Value

milestones.description: ServerScriptService.RoundController is enabled and server-run, with source references to RoundState, ordered Intermission then Playing then Ended phases and state assignment. Static source order does not prove a live cycle.
milestones.check:
local controller = game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):FindFirstChild("RoundController")
if not controller or not controller:IsA("Script") then
    return false, "Server RoundController Script is missing"
end
if not controller.Enabled or controller.RunContext == Enum.RunContext.Client then
    return false, "RoundController must run on the server"
end
local source = controller.Source
local intermission = source:find("Intermission", 1, true)
local playing = source:find("Playing", 1, true)
local ended = source:find("Ended", 1, true)
if not intermission or not playing or not ended then
    return false, "RoundController lacks all three phase source signatures"
end
if intermission >= playing or playing >= ended then
    return false, "RoundController phase source signatures are not ordered"
end
if not source:find("RoundState", 1, true) or not source:find(".Value =", 1, true) then
    return false, "RoundController lacks RoundState assignment source signature"
end
return true, "RoundController contains ordered phase transition source signatures"

milestones.description: Workspace contains LobbySpawn plus two or more SpawnLocations in Workspace.ArenaSpawns for players entering rounds.
milestones.check:
local lobby = workspace:FindFirstChild("LobbySpawn")
if not lobby or not lobby:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
    return false, "Workspace.LobbySpawn SpawnLocation is missing"
end
local arena = workspace:FindFirstChild("ArenaSpawns")
if not arena or not arena:IsA("Folder") then
    return false, "Workspace.ArenaSpawns folder is missing"
end
local count = 0
for _, child in ipairs(arena:GetChildren()) do
    if child:IsA("SpawnLocation") then
        count = count + 1
    end
end
if count < 2 then
    return false, "Need at least two arena SpawnLocations"
end
return true, "Lobby and " .. tostring(count) .. " arena spawn points are present"

milestones.description: ReplicatedStorage.RoundTime is a nonnegative IntValue and server RoundController source mentions RoundTime.Value and task.wait.
milestones.check:
local time = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"):FindFirstChild("RoundTime")
if not time or not time:IsA("IntValue") then
    return false, "ReplicatedStorage.RoundTime IntValue is missing"
end
if time.Value < 0 then
    return false, "RoundTime must be nonnegative"
end
local controller = game:GetService("ServerScriptService"):FindFirstChild("RoundController")
if not controller or not controller:IsA("Script") then
    return false, "Server RoundController Script is missing"
end
if not controller.Source:find("RoundTime.Value", 1, true) or not controller.Source:find("task.wait(", 1, true) then
    return false, "RoundController lacks timer update source signatures"
end
return true, "Round timer state and server update source signatures are present"
